title: expliCCit's memoryless actor trained offline on the single-value net1: a first grid
description: net2 in expliCCit's architecture: its actor (a memoryless network asked at every step) trained offline from logged steps on the net1 with one value per LCF (exp-net1-point-216, the run named in chosen.txt). Data: exp-data-net2-steps-222, 600 links no net1 trained on, 3,600 episodes of stock controllers, delay-threshold policies and the fixed rule, every step. Arms (experiments/specs/net2/offline.json): x-c*, expliCCit's own objective with its action (the window multiplier), Sage's reward on the action's own row and its deployed rounding, at penalty weights 0.1, 1 and 10; bc-*, cloning the logged actions; iql-* and td3bc-*, implicit Q-learning and TD3+BC; -mult arms output the multiplier, -bdp arms the window as a multiple of net1's believed BDP; -logu and td3bc arms use the log utility with 10-step returns. Seed 0, 20,000 updates each. This run only trains and reports each learner's diagnostics; no claim follows from it. The policies are compared in closed loop on validation links in a later run, and winners are confirmed over seeds before any test.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; O="$OUT/net2-off-$ARM"; mkdir -p "$O"; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg arm "$ARM" --slurpfile a experiments/specs/net2/offline.json '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", net1_from: $n, net2: $a[0][$arm]}' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| arm | transitions | actions clipped | validation BC error | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/net2-off-*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.actions_clipped, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
